question: In Concepcion v. answer:
The First Step Act (S. 3649) ultimately attracted 42 senatorial cosponsors. The very last few senators to add their names were **Senator Roger Wicker** (Mississippi), **Senator John Cornyn** (Texas), and **Senator Mike Lee** (Utah).  
Of those three, the only one who earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Mississippi is **Senator Roger Wicker**.

steps.text:
The First Step Act (S. 3649) ultimately attracted 42 senatorial cosponsors. The very last few senators to add their names were **Senator Roger Wicker** (Mississippi), **Senator John Cornyn** (Texas), and **Senator Mike Lee** (Utah).  
Of those three, the only one who earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Mississippi is **Senator Roger Wicker**.
